verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented headless mode, CLI, or CI integration for running jo in automation pipelines. The scheduled jobs and overnight cloud-machine work are a different capability: autonomous recurring tasks inside the product, not headless invocation. The exposed OpenAPI spec is an internal app/bridge API with no developer program or public API keys documented, so at most it is a building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
